problems: The blind guess (a raised-head bird in profile, swan or heron) only loosely matches. The drawing reads as a bird, but nothing in it reads as a gull with spread wings, so the species and the 'fell back' pose are lost.
The figure is right way up: crown star 78554 is at the top near (249,163), and tail stars 78072 and 77233 sit at the bottom near (281,323) and (336,328).

The wings are lopsided. Left wingtip 80816 (Thurá) sits far out at (104,191), while right wingtip 76852 is tucked in at about (358,233). Left wrist 80170 at (147,245) and left wing root 79043 at (219,293) form a long diagonal, but the right wing collapses into a small cluster around the breast.

Breast 78481 at about (320,268) sits inside the body, which is correct, but the right wing trailing edge 77450 and right wrist 77661 at (306,205) lie almost on top of the breast and tail lines, so the wing and body are hard to separate.

The labels collide. 'breast, centre of the body', 'right wing trailing edge', 'left wing root, on the trail(ing edge)' and 'root of the tail' overlap each other, and 'outer tail feather tip (Kassu)' runs off the right edge. Those labels are unreadable as drawn.

The blue outline is a real silhouette, not a copy of the gold lines, but it is a loose, scribbly loop. It has a tangled hook around the tail and neck and does not describe a clean bird shape. It needs a smoother, deliberate contour.
The gold lines are a simple zig-zag through the key stars, which is acceptable for a constellation, but they cut across the body instead of following the wing and body edges.
output.advice:
Redraw as a clean gull silhouette, side-on or slightly front-on with wings spread and the head raised. Keep it upright with the crown at the top.

1. Crown 78554: put it at the top of the head, around (249,163). Give the head and beak a clear, short, upward-pointing shape.
2. Breast 78481: centre the body around (320,268). Make the breast the widest point of the torso, not a point inside a tangle of lines.
3. Wings: mirror the spread so both wingtips sit at comparable distances from the body. Move left wingtip 80816 (Thurá) out to about (104,191) and place right wingtip 76852 at roughly (358,233) or further out to match. Place wrists 80170 (left, about (147,245)) and 77661 (right, about (306,205)) on the leading edge, one third of the way out from body to tip. Place left wing root 79043 on the trailing edge at about (219,293), and right wing trailing edge 77450 on the trailing edge between the right wrist and the body.
4. Tail: put the root 78072 at the body's lower end and fan the outer feather tip 77233 to the lower right, around (336,328), with the tail edge drawn as a short wedge.
5. Labels: stagger them on separate leader lines with at least 40 px between them. Move 'outer tail feather tip (Kassu)' to the left or below so it stays inside the frame.
6. Silhouette: replace the looping blue contour with a single smooth outline that runs crown, beak, back, wing tops, wingtips, wing undersides, tail and belly. Do not let it loop back on itself near the tail.
7. Gold lines: follow the outline's edges (crown to breast, breast to each wrist, wrist to wingtip) rather than cutting straight across the body."
